snippet.title: Cooking Fist Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Cooking Fist on Steam today!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3941360/Cooking_Fist/

Cooking Fist is a cooking-fighting game with NO health bars. You’ll have to cook up the best dishes to claim victory. Fight with a diverse roster of eight chefs, each with their own fighting and culinary styles. Challenge your friends locally or online with Rollback netcode!
